task: Lyrics G4 — German corpus (genius-de): Tier-1 CrhymeTV roster fetch, audit, ingest, verify

agents.name: G4 Fetch Auditor
agents.task: Audit the completed Genius roster fetch for the lyrics_g4 lane and report whether ingest may proceed.
instructions: Read ORCHESTRATION/lyrics_g4/ledger.md and Genious_lyrics_extractor/roster_g4.json for the expected 8-artist German roster and pinned ids.
Read every Genious_lyrics_extractor/status/*.json status file — verify status=done for all 8 artists and record songs count per artist.

Walk the corpus tree at D:\Projects\Music-AI-Toolshop\data\toolshop\lyrics\genius-de\ — list all category dirs (<artist>-solo/-featured/-duo/-trio, other-collab) and count *.json per dir (exclude _index.json/_dedup_log.json).
Spot-check 3 random song JSONs per artist for: genius_song_id populated (non-null), language='de', correct primary_artist, non-empty sections.
Flag: any artist not done, any genius_song_id=null, any language != 'de', any folder not matching a roster folder, suspicious misattribution (e.g. English-language titles under Maxwell/LX/Sa4).
Report per-artist totals + grand total. Verdict line: INGEST READY or FETCH INCOMPLETE (with the blocking list).
agents.scope: D:\Projects\Music-AI-Toolshop\data\toolshop\lyrics\genius-de\ and Genious_lyrics_extractor/status/ in the lyrics-g4 worktree
constraints: Read-only. Do NOT modify any files.
Do NOT run the fetcher, index builder, or build_database.
Corpus root is the SHARED canonical path (data/toolshop under the main repo), not the worktree's data dir.

agents.name: G4 DB Ingester
agents.task: Ingest the fetched German corpus into lyrics.db as corpus='genius-de' (fresh corpus build).
instructions: Precondition: wave-1 handoff verdict must be INGEST READY; if not, stop and write that in your handoff.
Record pre-ingest baseline read-only: songs total, per-corpus counts (expect 8 corpora), rhyme_pairs count.
Run: D:\Projects\Music-AI-Toolshop\.venv\Scripts\toolshop.exe lyrics build-db --corpus genius-de with PYTHONPATH including the lyrics-g4 worktree so lane code is used. Fresh corpus — first build.

Post-ingest verify: genius-de row count = audited file count minus dedup drops (quote _dedup_log.json); all rows language='de', license_tier='study-only', release_ok='no'; solo roster folders non-NULL genre_cohort='german_drill'; ZERO line_rhymes rows for genius-de (populate_rhymes skipped by design); all other corpora counts unchanged; PRAGMA integrity_check=ok; PRAGMA foreign_key_check empty.
Record all counts (before/after) in the handoff.
agents.scope: Genious_lyrics_extractor/, toolshop/ in the lyrics-g4 worktree; canonical db at D:\Projects\Music-AI-Toolshop\data\toolshop\lyrics\lyrics.db
constraints: Modify only: genius-de corpus _index.json/_dedup_log.json, lyrics.db (via build_database), ORCHESTRATION artifacts.
Corpus-scoped build only — never touch other corpora.
Do NOT commit; the orchestrator owns commits.

agents.name: G4 Verifier
agents.task: Verify the genius-de corpus landed cleanly: cohort tagging, language stamping, rhyme-skip, misattribution, release-safety, tests green.
instructions: Read wave-1 and wave-2 handoffs plus ORCHESTRATION/lyrics_g4/ledger.md for claimed counts.
NULL-cohort audit: genius-de solo-folder rows with genre_cohort IS NULL — expected zero; list any found.
Misattribution spot-check: per artist folder, sample 5 titles and confirm primary_artist matches roster_g4.json variants (Maxwell/LX/Sa4 extra care — US R&B singer false-positive check).
Language audit: all genius-de rows language='de'; spot-check clean_lyrics contains German text.
Rhyme-skip audit: COUNT line_rhymes for genius-de must be 0; rhyme_pairs must still equal pre-ingest count.
Release-safety smoke: confirm corpus='genius-de' rows all release_ok='no' and no export path includes them.
Test rerun: pytest lane tests (test_lyricsdb_g4_de, test_syllables_de, roster_g4 tests, test_lyrics_sources_core) + the 62-test #087 gate set — must be green.
Handoff: VERDICT pass/fail per check + follow-ups.
agents.scope: lyrics.db (read-only queries), roster_g4.json, tests/ in the lyrics-g4 worktree
constraints: Read-only against lyrics.db and corpus files. Test runs allowed.
Do NOT modify production code to make checks pass — report findings instead.
Do NOT export or print copyrighted lyric text — counts and metadata only.
